The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1930–1931''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[AFC Ajax]] won this year's championship by beating [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[PSV Eindhoven]], [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]] and [[Velocitas 1897]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Meppeler Sport Club]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV De Valk|De Valk]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[HVV 't Gooi]], [[Hermes DVS]], [[Koninklijke HFC]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]], [[VUC (football club)|VUC]] and [[ZFC (football club)|ZFC]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[ADO Den Haag]], [[RCH (football club)|RCH]], [[FC Hilversum]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[KFC (football club)|KFC]]
